learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to implement a larger programming project using an object-oriented and modular approach with C++.
They understand how to design aspects of a task with diverse programming options (loops, recursions, if-statements, functions, classes).
They can create or select and use appropriate data types for the respective application area, such as arrays, pointers, classes.
Using analytical skills learned in the lecture, students can comprehend programs, evaluate their execution, and improve or correct them.

syllabus_topics: Simple and complex data types: Strings, arrays (one- and two-dimensional), Pointers
Problem solving through iterations and recursion
Methods for converting tasks into program code

assessment_methods.method: Homework project (teamwork) consisting of a larger programming task with a report and demonstration of the project.

assessment_rules: The assessment will evaluate a short demonstration, explanation of the code, the report, program execution, and the programming itself. Prerequisite for the examination (XP): passing 2 out of 2 tests and presenting the project outline.
